onboarding.s1.title: Connect Cursor
onboarding.s1.body:
TaroCode talks to Cursor through a debug link (CDP).

  • 🟢Green circle — everything is ready.
  • 🔴Red — press ◎ and launch Cursor with CDP, or the app will not work.
onboarding.s2.title: Top controls
onboarding.s2.body:
These buttons run the deck:

  • 👁Show or hide the card deck
  • ?Open this tour again
  • ⚙Open Settings
  • ◎CDP status / launch Cursor
  • 💬Full chats window
  • ✕Quit TaroCode
onboarding.s3.title: Switch decks
onboarding.s3.body:
This is the deck switcher.

The name shows the active deck; ‹ and › flip between ready-made prompt packs.
onboarding.s4.title: Chat list
onboarding.s4.body:
These are the chats that receive prompts from your cards.

  • ●Each item is a saved Cursor chat and its status (running, waiting, and so on).
  • +Add a new Cursor chat to the list.
  • 💀Remove extra chats and keep only the one you are using now.
onboarding.s5.title: Cursor messages
onboarding.s5.body: Here you read the selected Cursor chat — the same thread you see in the IDE.

onboarding.s6.title: Type or dictate
onboarding.s6.body:
Manual mode is for short commands without a card.

Open it, type or tap 🎤 to dictate, then press Send.
onboarding.s7.title: Nice progress!
onboarding.s7.body:
You already know the main controls.

Next up: the cards themselves — the heart of TaroCode.
onboarding.s8.title: Prompt cards
onboarding.s8.body:
You rarely need to invent prompts from scratch.

  • 🂠Each card is a ready prompt.
  • 👆Click — it pastes into the selected chat.
  • 👀Hover — peek at the prompt text.
onboarding.s9.title: Phone remote
onboarding.s9.body:
Same Wi‑Fi as this PC.

Just scan the QR code with your phone — that is enough to open the remote.
onboarding.s10.title: Edit decks
onboarding.s10.body:
In Decks you reshape the product for yourself:

  • ✎Rename decks and rewrite any card.
  • ＋Add or remove cards (up to 9).
  • ⌨Optional hotkeys if you want them.
onboarding.s11.title: Tour complete!
onboarding.s11.body:
You made it — TaroCode is ready for vibe-coding.

New adventures ahead. Go build something fun.
